dataset_name: Korean AI Curriculum — Stage 1 Split Manifest

held-out_v2.1.description: held-out v2.2 로 대체됨(2026-08-30). correct_index 위치 편향(chi2=50.1) 때문이며, 후보 내용은 v2.2 와 동일하다 — 순서만 다르다. 재현·이력 확인용으로 보존한다.

held-out_v2_archive.description: 이전 held-out_v2 benchmark의 보존용 archive. 현재 실험 및 최종 benchmark에 사용하지 않는다.

held-out_v1_archive.description: 이전 held-out_v1 benchmark의 보존용 archive. 현재 실험 및 최종 benchmark에 사용하지 않는다.

roles.train: Stage 1 추가 학습에 사용되는 900개. 기존 300M-token standard pretraining에 혼입하지 않고, 기존 pretrained 100M 모델에 별도로 추가 학습한다.
roles.val: Stage 1 추가 학습 중 validation 및 checkpoint 선택에 사용하는 100개. gradient update에는 사용하지 않는다.
roles.held-out_v2.1: held-out v2.2 로 대체됨(2026-08-30). 위치 편향 때문. 보존용이며 새 실험에 쓰지 않는다.
roles.held-out_v2_archive: 이전 held-out_v2 benchmark의 보존용 archive. 실험 데이터로 사용하지 않는다.
roles.held-out_v1_archive: 이전 held-out_v1 benchmark의 보존용 archive. 실험 데이터로 사용하지 않는다.
roles.held-out_v2.2: train/ 및 val/과 완전히 분리된 **현재 최종** semantic benchmark 300개. forced-choice likelihood / paired-margin 평가에 사용한다. v2.1 대비 후보 순서만 무작위 재배열됐고 내용은 동일하다.

legacy_benchmarks.reason: 이전 held-out_v2는 현재 held-out_v2_archive에 보존되어 있으며, held-out_v2.1과 benchmark lineage가 이어지므로 validation이나 다른 실험 split으로 재사용하지 않는다.
이전 benchmark 버전의 보존용 데이터이므로 현재 실험에 사용하지 않는다.
correct_index position bias: {0:27, 1:73, 2:110, 3:90}, chi2(3)=50.1, always-index-2 strategy scored 36.7% against 25% chance

rules: train + val = the original 1,000-example Stage 1 prototype.
held-out_v2.1 is a separate 300-example benchmark and is not part of the 1,000-example Stage 1 prototype.
actual Stage 1 additional training should read train/stage1_train_text_900.jsonl only for gradient updates.
validation should read val/stage1_val_text_100.jsonl only and must not be used for gradient updates.

the current prototype comparison is Model A versus Model B: Model A is the existing 300M-token pretrained 100M checkpoint with no Stage 1 additional training; Model B starts from the same checkpoint and receives Stage 1 train/900 additional training.
held-out_v2.1 benchmark evaluation should be performed only after the Model B checkpoint has been fixed using the train/ and val/ process.
held-out_v2.1 must not be used for checkpoint selection, hyperparameter tuning, curriculum modification, training, or model selection.
held-out_v2.1 is the only benchmark split eligible for final benchmark reporting in the current experiment.

held-out_v2_archive and held-out_v1_archive are archive-only directories and must not be used for training, validation, checkpoint selection, hyperparameter tuning, model selection, or final benchmark evaluation.
the archived held-out_v2 and held-out_v1 data must not be moved into train or val because they are part of the benchmark lineage leading to held-out_v2.1.
the held-out_v2.1 benchmark uses its already implemented benchmark-specific forced-choice likelihood and paired-margin scoring schema; no older free-generation scoring schema is used.

once held-out_v2.1 results are inspected and used to change training, checkpoint selection, hyperparameters, curriculum, data composition, model architecture, tokenizer, or model selection, that evaluation is no longer treated as a blind final test and must be treated as development evaluation.

benchmark.purpose: Stage 1의 새로운 개념·관계·경계 일반화 능력을 외부 LLM judge 없이 평가한다.

manifest_updated_by: position-bias fix; held-out v2.2 promoted to current benchmark

G4_correct_is_longest.note: pre-existing; identical in v2.1 (58.0%). v2.2 changed order only.

G5_trivial_baseline_max.note: position strategies now exactly 25.0% each; length is the binding term

v2.2_audit_2026_08_30.conclusion: v2.2 fixed position bias completely and preserved content exactly. Length bias remains and needs v2.3 or a scorer-side length control.
